title: Invoice subtotal off by a cent from line items
text: Hartline's AP system auto-rejected 11 invoices last week with "line items do not sum to invoice total", and each one is off by a cent. Invoice INV-204417 prints lines of $2,989.27, $545.82 and $125.03 (those add up to $3,660.12), but the subtotal and total print as $3,660.11. AP re-adds every invoice, so it has to tie out to the cent. The totals come from `build_invoice` in `invoice_lines.py`.
